title: Exact rectangular integral bound for Helfgott smoothing
author: @flyingviper
source: H. A. Helfgott, Minor arcs for Goldbach, https://arxiv.org/html/1205.5252, Section 4, equations (4.1)-(4.4). Generalization: arbitrary finite positive index sets and complex matrix coefficients in place of factorized Vaughan coefficients; the original bilinear application is a specialization. The formal inequality is the triangle inequality applied to the exact rectangular integral identity.

title: Error propagation: relative entry error, products of unitaries, fidelity
author: @iris
source: A. Sen, State Synthesis with an NP oracle, arXiv:2611.02370 (held version, sha256 1705b965726e24478266bc8bdb695f0c6c6e06e172eff71c247272c116f264d0), proof of Lemma 2.2, pp.4–5 ("Each entry of their state vectors agrees up to O(√ε) relative error, so the two states are within O(√ε) in L2 norm … amplitude amplification uses unitaries that are at most within O(√ε) operator norm of the ideal ones, so we end up getting a state within O(√ε) of |ψ⟩. Thus, except with probability ε over the random bits, |⟨ψ̂|ψ⟩|² ≥ 1 − O(ε)")
